sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

BALOCHISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION
BALOCHISTAN MOTOR
VEHICLES TAXATION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVII OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act,
1958
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th October, 2002]
No.Legis:4-23/Law/71-V, dated
30-10-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
26th October, 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1).This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Motor
Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Act XXXII of 1958

BALOCHISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION
BALOCHISTAN MOTOR
VEHICLES TAXATION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVII OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act,
1958
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th October, 2002]
No.Legis:4-23/Law/71-V, dated
30-10-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
26th October, 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Act XXXII of 1958.-----In the Balochistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act,
1958, the full-stop appearing at the end of second proviso of subsection (1) of
section 3, shall be substituted with a colon and thereafter the following new
proviso shall be added:
"Provided
also that 10 6 discount shall be admissible to the owner of any Motor Vehicle
who pays the road tax for whole year i.e. 1st July to 30th June in lump sum in
first month of financial year i.e. up to 31st July.".
